File save validates extension/path length/duplicate, allows overwrite refusal and retry/cancel. Inner save failure Try Again re-enters save; outer chain normalizes a resolved FAILED to SUCCESS, so caller completion alone is not proof of a saved file.

Buffer worker writes full/chunked data.json with separate ACK/completion. Whole/final ACK-enabled write finally settles worker deferred, but rejected nonfinal chunk leaves it pending and close stalls.
Caller waits saveFinish plus info.json before adding tree node and refreshing hashes. Close call itself only posts a command and resolves, not a synchronous disk flush.
DataList sorts/deduplicates timestamps, retains 2.8-hour rolling window; save all/last/flag-window or configured pre/post-trigger slice normalizes recordTime and sequence numbers.
DRS-derived monitor data and metadata use session JSON layout; flush hashes then archives, choosing current hash.cpt policy after2025.

Native monitor/active-test CSV exporter receives parameter.json, app6; UI polls JSON absence or connection disappearance for completion and sends command99 on cancel. Web formats export separately; completion is not a per-output success proof.

Offline execution of authenticated constants gives current extension.gtse, format0.0.1, JSON member names and list.cpt current/list.txt legacy hash manifests.
Ordinary Graph Viewer app2 gets selected stored-data relative path; monitor exists before launch and is stopped if launch rejects.

Acquisition joins recorder/header logs->CreateVdasFile->delete logs->optional CSV. VDAS create failure is caught/resolved, so log deletion still runs; interruption sets flag, cancels command, removes logs and attempted VDAS/CSV outputs, then polls200ms for producer completion. PCS app3 receives complete VDAS path; folder launcher app1 receives saved folder.

Nonfinal divided-write rejection before ACK posts Failed and resolves only local return; appended deferred remains pending so savingProm and cmdClose never settle. Final ACK-enabled write finalizer instead resolves deferred even on error.
Per-key completion handler is installed only by saveAck. Failed completion without ACK has no callback and is dropped; caller defSave remains pending, even if whole-save worker deferred settles.
Live Datalist saveAll/saveLast/saveFlag/saveType1 paths invoke divided saving; pre-ACK chunk stall is reachable from normal recording save.

Recovery clears for verified root manifest or missing folder list, after skipped ineligible-version export, and after eligible export resolves result:false from caught failure. Returned export result is not tested; wildcard deletion is not gated by preserved archive.
